name: civic_v1
doc: A civic building (design/planner.md, Civic buildings): the game asks for a type (a config entry: a church, a temple, a court, a town hall, a guild hall, a library, a bank, a mage's tower, a market hall, or a centre a square's road rings: a well, a market cross, a fountain, a maypole, a statue, a shrine), its lot's size, how grand it is, and the season; build makes it on its lot, and the house animator swings its bells, sways its banners and ribbons, flickers its lamps, and opens its door.

params.name: type
params.doc: A type: one entry from config/civic_v1_types/.

params.name: size
params.doc: Its lot: centre (flower7, a square's middle), small (rect6x5), large (rect9x7), or great (rect12x9). A planner gives the type's own size.

params.name: theme
params.doc: The village's theme from config/village_v1_themes/: its roofs, plan, walls, windows, ornaments, colours, and fires (heartland keeps the type's own).

params.name: stage
params.doc: How far it has come: planning (its lot staked out, its trench dug, stone and timber piled), half (its walls half up in scaffolding), finished, or a ruin (broken, roofless, overgrown).

params.name: grandeur
params.doc: How grand it is: plain, fine, grand (gilding, statues, braziers), or wondrous (the exotic: twin domed towers crowned with crystals, flying buttresses and a rose window, burning braziers and a gilded figure, a ring of crystals circling a mage's tower, a gilded dome over a well).

params.name: detail
params.doc: Level of detail; the runtime picks it from distance and quality.

params.name: wind_heading
params.doc: Toward which the wind blows, from +Z toward +X.

params.name: door_time
params.doc: Seconds since its door opened; negative while shut. The game starts it when someone comes through; it opens, stays a moment, and closes.
